Name: Teatotaller Farmer
Author: Quirinea
Description:
This is for players that do not wish to handle alcoholic beverages even virtually.
[list]
[*]The events where the player is required to drink are modified (Shane and Elliott ones)
[*]Pam's quest for pale ale is replaced -- she asks for kvass (a Scandinavian non-alcoholic malt drink) instead
[*]Pam does not send you beer (replaced with Muscle Remedy)
[*]fruits in keg are produced into nectar instead of wine
[*]hops in keg is producing kvass (this is less profitable than the ale in original game) 
[*]honey in keg becomes lemonade
[*]none of the bundles (both standard and remixed) require wine, beer, ale or mead
[*]As aged wine is one of the most profitable products in the base game I have added two products made in an iron cask:
[/list][list=1]
[*] Fermented pickles (six weeks in a cask turns regular pickles into a very healthy product)
[*]Fish preserve (two weeks and any seafood acquires a new value)
[/list]
Gus still sells beer, etc. as well as the trading chart. I have changed some Lewis' dialog, but Pam still says she'll buy you a drink. Pam's special quest has been left as it is (nah, she asks for juice and the result is not what she expects. Or then you can just skip that quest). Also you can still get mead from the pirate cove (I didn't find where to replace it with something else; probably would need C#-coding and I've not been into that)

[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2642]Custom cask mod[/url] is a nice addition (aging pickles comes as default).

Perfection can be achieved only by buying the necessary items or using [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8615]Perfection tweaker[/url]﻿.
